faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started
faq.q1: What does the Pro plan include?
faq.a1: The Pro plan includes: 128 professional templates, unlimited CVs, 7 AI tools (bullet improvement, summary generator, ATS Score, skill suggestions, CV review, profile fill, cover letter), PDF and Word export, application tracker, public shareable CV and version history.
faq.q2: Can I change templates without losing my data?
faq.a2: Yes. Your data is separated from the template. You can switch between 128 templates at any time and your content stays intact.
faq.q3: In what formats can I download my CV?
faq.a3: You can download as high-resolution PDF or Word (.docx), ready to edit. Both formats included in the Pro plan.
faq.q4: Can I create more than one CV?
faq.a4: Yes. With the Pro plan you can create unlimited CVs, allowing you to tailor your resume for different positions or industries.
faq.q5: Can I import my existing CV?
faq.a5: Yes. You can import your CV in PDF or Word (.docx) format and the system will automatically extract your information to populate the editor.
faq.a6: Absolutely. We use bank-level encryption and never share your data with third parties. You can delete your account and all your data at any time.

ats_section.title: 75% of CVs are rejected before a recruiter sees them
ats_section.subtitle: Most companies use Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to filter candidates automatically. If your CV doesn't match the job posting's keywords, it never reaches a human — no matter how qualified you are.
